special_card.old: - Special: follow its conditions, defense and location.
special_card.new: - Special: follow its conditions, defense and location. The original rulebook's illustrated special card chooses the other player with the most current foreign colonies, excluding offense. Break a tie toward offense's left, choosing the first tied eligible player there; encounter that player in their home system (rulebook p7).
special_card.primary: Original rulebook p7 illustrated special, extraction603–612

gambler_note.old: **FAQ pp3,14:** Against Oracle you must reveal or announce your bluff before Oracle chooses a card. On Gambler Super, the old term token means ship. The standard printed Sorcerer incompatibility is retained here; the FAQ permits relaxing it if players accept that Sorcerer may know the card.
gambler_note.new: **FAQ pp3,14; FAQ p5:** Against Oracle you must reveal or announce your bluff before Oracle chooses a card. On Gambler Super, the old term token means ship. The standard printed Sorcerer incompatibility is retained here; the FAQ permits relaxing it if players accept that Sorcerer may know the card. The losing player chooses extra penalty ships under their control outside the encounter, ordinarily ships on their colonies in this original-base scope.
gambler_note.primary: Original Gambler non-involved restriction plus FAQp5 extraction419–423/450–453

source_precision: Ordinarily is non-exhaustive; no unsupported extra holding/location rule.
